name: cosmic-plan
description: COSMIC function-point estimation plan: given one requirement and the green project context, plan which modules to add or modify — each changed leaf module becomes one function with hierarchical names and estimated CFPs (consumes a green cosmic-context artifact).

cfpPerFunc.description: Per-function CFP budget {value, min, max}: every estimatedCfps must fall inside [min, max] (rule plan/cfp-per-func-band)

cfpTotal.description: Total CFP budget {value, downFactor, upFactor}: totalCfps must fall inside [value*downFactor, value*upFactor] (rule plan/cfp-total-band); no default — state the budget via params, downstream stages inherit it

cfpPerSubProc.description: Average CFP per data movement; sizing guidance carried to the downstream func/tech stages

moduleLevels.description: Depth of the module tree (1-3) as declared by the upstream cosmic-context artifact: drives l2Name/l3Name requiredness and the funcId segment-count floor (rule plan/name-hierarchy); inherited from the context receipt
